items.title: Modules over a topological group form a category with functorial injective embeddings
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the category of modules over a topological group with a ring has functorial injective embeddings (statement lines 625-633). The proof is a complete argument: the author introduces the functor sending a module to the submodule of elements with open stabilizer, recalls the companion functor and its properties (proof lines 635-644), checks that the companion sends no nonzero module to zero, and applies the transfer result for adjoint pairs to conclude (proof lines 645-646). The non-formal content is the construction of the functor and the verification of the hypothesis. The claim is H2.
